scope: Robot initial planar station only; no action rollout, physics or scoring change.

coordinate_frame.origin: midpoint of shelf front edge at floor projection
coordinate_frame.lateral: source world +X, rotated with shelf in other layouts
coordinate_frame.inward: source world +Y, rotated with shelf in other layouts
coordinate_frame.robot_reference: base/root origin, not robot hull or hands

mapping: base = front_midpoint + lateral_axis*(nominal_lateral+dx) + inward_axis*(-nominal_standoff+dy); heading = inward_heading + nominal_heading_error + dyaw. Transform station with the actual shelf, not separately toward each product.
constraints: Use existing collision/initial-state validity checks; sampled range alone is not proof of feasibility in every layout.
Station mapping changes no robot Z, dynamics, scoring or control. The separately approved source_ready_pose.json owns shelf-task joint initialization.
Do not substitute observed finite-sample extrema for the source generator bounds.
runtime_note: Local target_spawn.py and prepare_task.py select source_ready_pose.json for shelf tasks. Remote task-owned candidate passed layout 03 CPU geometry and launch admission; remote shared snapshot unchanged. Native settling and actions not run. The previous rejection report is historical.
